text:
Maria: Heads-up — we need a lightweight telemetry shim from runtime that emits per-request tenant tags + routing_decision and quota_consume fields. This is for the new customer dashboard work. cc @Chris @Alex

Chris: Where will this live? runtime or sidecar? I'm leaning runtime minimal emit to avoid extra hops.

Alex: runtime sounds right. we need a versioned contract though. propose metric names and a small request schema so ingestion can validate: redwood.request.count, redwood.request.latency_ms, redwood.request.kv_cache_hit, redwood.request.routing_policy, redwood.request.quota_units

Chris: agreed on contract. quick draft schema below — keep it lightweight, flattened, and hash tenant_id before it leaves the host:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "org_123",
  "request_id": "req_abc",
  "model": "gptx-8k",
  "seq_len": 512,
  "latency_ms": 120,
  "tokens_in": 34,
  "tokens_out": 78,
  "routing_policy": "regional-fastest",
  "quota_units": 1.2,
  "kv_cache_hit": true
}
```

Jen: UX note — console will need per-org toggle to show any identifying info. privacy wants tenant_id hashed on the wire, and the console should be able to opt-in to show hashed id only. Also noisy-neighbor detection requires composite signals (tail latency spikes + sudden token burn).

Maria: +1. add hashed_tenant_id and an isolation_signal enum: normal|noisy|throttled. include a normalized_billing_units field for the console to surface cost trends.

Chris: console team also asked for a rollout hook: when isolation_signal==noisy, we should be able to trigger model fallback routing automatically. That implies routing_policy and route_id fields in the shim so the console can present a suggested action. Also need an on-demand backfill API for last-90-days for customer dashboards.

Alex: tentative backfill plan: runtime logs -> metrics-proxy -> pipeline -> per-tenant TSDB. This requires adding tenant metadata to the producer; privacy approved hashing approach but we need KMS for the hash salt.

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime-metrics-shim v0.1 -> canary us-west-2 tomorrow 10:00 UTC (:robot_face:)

Maria: Handoff checklist for eng-platform -> console/infrastructure:
1) contract doc link (WIP)
2) console wireframes + isolation UX notes
3) schema version = 0.1 (hashing required)
4) rollout plan + canary thresholds (error rate delta < 0.5%, p99 latency delta < 20ms)
5) KMS key + privacy sign-off

Chris: I'll open the schema PR today and add tests for hashed_tenant_id and sample payloads. tagging @Jen for UX mocks.

Jen: Will add mocks by EOD. quick q — for quota_units are we using billing_units (normalized) or raw tokens? Product prefers normalized billing units (per-1k tokens) so dashboards don't need to convert.

Maria: let's include both: normalized_billing_units and raw_tokens_in/raw_tokens_out. console can pick.

Alex: also add route_capacity_tier (hosted|dedicated|private) so dashboards can group customers by capacity and surface noisy neighbors per tier.

Chris: ack. any objections to shipping v0.1 with hashed_tenant_id only (no plain tenant_id) and route + billing fields?

Jen: thumbs up :thumbsup:

Maria: Great. Next steps: Chris opens PR, Alex wires ingest pipeline changes and runs canary, Jen posts UX mocks, I'll update the contract doc and notify privacy. We'll sync in eng-platform standup tomorrow.
